summary: Added static __inline XDK wrappers in the xdk-oss header tree so the 51 TUs' bare source-level names (socket/XUser*/XShow*/XNet*/XContent*/XInputGetKeystroke/XLaunchNewImage/XCloseHandle/XHasOverlappedIoCompleted) bind to the real Xam*/NetDll_* xam.xex exports. 51/51 recompile clean; fresh link probe confirms ZERO bare wrapper names remain unresolved (all now resolve to underlying exports). XHasOverlappedIoCompleted is an inline over XOVERLAPPED (not an export).

wrapper_design.caller_arg: WSA_XNCALLER_SYSTEM = 2 (matches Xenia XNCALLER_SYSAPP; XDK winsockx.h convention). Xenia ignores caller; permission-context hint on hardware.
wrapper_design.XUserGetXUID_type_mask: XamUserGetXUID takes an extra type-mask arg the XUser* form lacks; wrapper passes 7 (all XUID types), which Xenia's assert accepts. Exact XDK constant unconfirmed; only exercised on the online/GoCentral path, never at DllMain/boot.
wrapper_design.XCloseHandle: inline alias for CloseHandle (Lane A shim over NtClose@207)

lane_I_gap.already_in_xam_def: All NetDll_* (@1..@27, @51..@78) and XamUserGet*/XamShow*/XamLoaderLaunchTitle are already present in L-importlibs/xam.def; they resolve by construction once K/L consumption is wired.
lane_I_gap.ordinal_source: idaxex namegen.cpp export table for xam.xex v2.0.21256 (the table whose XamUserGetXUID=0x20A=@522 matches stock_imports.txt exactly).
lane_I_gap.lane_A_dependency: CloseHandle (XCloseHandle's target) is the xapilib Win32->NtClose@207 shim owned by Lane A.

deferred_not_simple_rename.reason: These are XONLINE library functions (see decomp-clones/ChimpsAtSea_Reach/src/xdk/xonlined/xliveimp.cpp; statically-linked in the stock DLL), NOT single xam.xex exports and NOT in the idaxex ordinal DB. They cannot be simple inline rename wrappers. Left as plain externs in xam.h. Need a Lane A/C decision: a small xonline shim/stub (RB3E hooks XInviteGetAcceptedInfo anyway and only calls the original as a fallback). Also still unresolved: XNetLogonGetExtendedStatus (@315, in xam.def, declared by RB3E's own xbox360.h).

probe.note: Probe linked against L-importlibs/{xam,xboxkrnl}.lib; underlying NetDll_*/Xam* names reappear as unresolved by design (the Lane-H -> Lane-I/L handoff surface). NetDll_UpnpStartup (a DIRECT RB3E ref, unrelated to my wrappers) is unresolved identically, proving the residual is a lib-consumption/join concern (xam.lib DOES contain NetDll_socket + __imp_NetDll_socket), not a decoration bug in the wrappers.
